purpose: Evaluate a causal dual-route competing-auction system on both revealed BTC development weeks. A v107 auction event is not entered immediately. The first completed one-minute close to break the confirmation range selects either rotation to the pre-observed auction center or continuation to a confirmed-break measured move; activation is one completed minute later. NautilusTrader 1.230.0, fixed realistic costs, current NAV risk 3%, no arbitrary notional cap.
